semiconductor_relevance: High — Gentec specializes in gas flow control equipment specifically designed for high purity and ultra-high purity applications in the semiconductor industry.
summary: Gentec (Shanghai) Corporation provides high purity and ultra-high purity gas flow control equipment essential for semiconductor manufacturing. Their product offerings include pressure regulators, diaphragm valves, and fittings, all designed to meet stringent SEMI standards for purity and reliability.
capabilities: High purity and ultra-high purity gas pressure regulators
UHP diaphragm valves with metal-to-metal sealing technology
VCR face seal fittings and weld fittings
Precision machining and advanced welding technologies

regional_presence.China: Gentec operates in China, focusing on high purity gas flow control solutions for the semiconductor industry.
